# Else Kjær Mikkelsen

Else Kjær Mikkelsen is a specialist nurse (Specialeansvarlig sygeplejerske) employed by [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] who serves as a steering committee member of [[danibd|DANIBD]], Denmark's national database for inflammatory bowel disease [^src1] [^src2]. She is listed as a member of the DANIBD steering committee in both the 2023 and 2024 annual reports, representing nursing expertise and regional perspectives as part of the multidisciplinary governance structure that oversees clinical data collection and quality across the Danish IBD healthcare system [^src1] [^src2].
